name: smwmusic-pok-mon-red-blue-yellow-pok-mon-caught
title: Pokémon Red/Blue/Yellow - Pokémon Caught
description:
Unsampled port of the fanfare that plays when you catch a Pokémon in the first generation Pokémon games (Red, Blue and Yellow). Includes a version that includes SMW's goal whistle.

Fits goal and keyhole themes.
